# Existing-method numerical qualification admission blocker

Source: Research_Autopilot at 1de12dfed5b84957b29ac5b3a2f04904bf3742bc, scripts/run_experiments.py, scripts/_native_eval.py and references/native-evaluation.md.

Scientific developmental execution collects non-gate results, but still requires N.verify_protocol. There is no separate native_reference_qualification/scientific_preparation purpose or registered audit-protocol schema in this revision. The only plan purposes are engineering and scientific.

_native_eval._scorer requires runnable argv, code/source references, cwd, JSON stdout/file output and a denominator path. _verify_single_protocol checks both the selected scorer and native_definition.scorer and rejects an upstream-definition scorer whose kind is not official (NATIVE_OFFICIAL_SCORER_REQUIRED). Paper equations without runnable native scoring code/interface do not satisfy this implemented contract.

A faithful_harness scorer additionally requires source-bound verification matching the official/harness implementations, released sample manifest and native-sourced metric tolerances. verify_run replays both pinned scorers on each arm's same predictions and accepts metric values from the official scorer. Mathematical review of a corrected projector scorer alone does not supply the missing authentic upstream executable/parity interface.

Audited incorrect author recourse metrics and scripts without a predictions-to-JSON scoring interface cannot be relabeled compatible official scoring. Project-local repaired code is not an upstream official release merely because its mathematics was reviewed.

Stable rejection codes include NATIVE_SCORER_COMMAND_REQUIRED, NATIVE_OUTPUT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED, NATIVE_SCORER_CODE_REQUIRED, NATIVE_OFFICIAL_SCORER_REQUIRED and NATIVE_FAITHFUL_HARNESS_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.

Keep numerical Rice/Skin baseline/evaluator qualification pending on a real compatible trusted scorer/adapter capability. Do not fabricate an official designation, gate protocol/pass, parity result, engineering/maintenance relabel or raw experiment driver. Existing-source reading, independently reviewed baseline/evaluator code and complete design may continue. Mechanical authorized input integrity/materialization is separate preparation evidence.

This is a source-admission finding, not a failed scientific experiment or proof that a faithful mathematical scorer is impossible. No scientific process, protocol, gate or scorer parity test was executed by this staging task.
